notes.title: Sanctuary Saga v1.2 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey Caravan Crew!! We hope you all are as excited for v1.2 as we are. We are so grateful for the community feedback that helped shape these changes. This really feels like the game’s final form, where any major systems added in the future are likely to be DLC expansions as opposed to updates. 

[h2]Community Support [/h2]

We wanted to take some time and thank the existing Sanctuary Saga community for partnering with us. Not only has your feedback been super helpful in improving the game but we’ve enjoyed watching your videos and reading your comments. One way players can help out Indie Developers is to simply rate the game on Steam. This has a massive impact on the algorithm and is honestly the next-best way to support us outside of buying the game. 

Please continue to tell others what you think about the game on your socials or by word-of-mouth. We have great plans for the Untamed Wilds and would love the opportunity to keep making content for you to enjoy!

[h2]Sanctuary Saga v1.1 and v1.2 Patch Notes[/h2]

We’ve already written about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1582200/view/3718324471684733608?l=english]v1.1[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1582200/view/3717199657497419829]1.2[/url]  respectively, so this is just to reiterate that both are on the Default branch now and ready for play! It is recommended that everyone start a fresh Save File since many of the changes are set at Save File initialization. We think you’ll want to experience the new progression system anyway, since we feel it makes the game much more interesting!

Full combined patch notes can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TWdQy0hGUEAz8SkVubftbL_fx3siGPCJ6PUIuHN5iA0/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url].

[h2]v1.01 Branch on Steam[/h2]

For those who aren’t wanting to experience the updated content until they’ve finished their runs of v1.01, we will be adding a separate branch on Steam for this. To stay on v1.01, simply right click on Sanctuary Saga in your Steam Library, select Properties, navigate to the Betas tab, and select the appropriate build from the drop down menu. We recommend assigning your Save Files to specific builds so you can keep them between versions if you plan to play through both separately. 

[h2]Next Steps[/h2]

Over the course of the next few weeks we’ll be keeping an eye on the Bug Report form and fixing any issues as we’re made aware of them. Once v1.2 is stable for a while we’ll start to look at porting it to OSX and Linux (hoping we can get some help on this one; none of us own a Linux box). As the community grows, we fully intend to make Sanctuary Saga available to as many people as possible on their chosen PC operating system! 

Unfortunately, a console port is out of scope at this time and we would need to see some serious moves in sales before we can even begin to take on that level of cost. We’ve been asked this several times and wish we had a different answer but RPG Maker MV doesn’t have an easy method for reliably porting to consoles. If this is something we plan for in the future we will post a News update. 


Phew! That there is an update! Let us know what you think on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582200/discussions/0/]Discussion[/url] page or in our [url=https://discord.gg/3BkT35J]Discord[/url].  

See you in the Wilds!

notes.title: v1.2 on Experimental!
notes.content:
Hey caravan crew! We’re back with news on Update v1.2, now on the Experimental Branch! We plan to leave this on Experimental for at least a week and see how the community reacts before pushing it to the Live branch. If you want to participate, please see our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1582200/view/3718324471684733608?l=english]last blog post[/url] on using the Experimental Branch. Without further delay, Patch Info!!

[h2]Sanctuary Saga v1.2 Patch Notes[/h2]

The v1.2 Build focused on adjustments to early game progression and reworked the Skill progression system. Full patch notes can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TWdQy0hGUEAz8SkVubftbL_fx3siGPCJ6PUIuHN5iA0/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url]. We anticipate the Skill rework changes will allow players to ease into the main party since each player character will start with fewer skills. Hopefully, it will also encourage more varied party compositions as players match teammates for skill building in addition to their favorite battle set-up. This should help keep battles feeling fresh until such a time when enemies start to learn their own new tricks…

There are, of course, a few new QoL improvements and numerous bug fixes as well. Most notable: Expedition Maps will now show players where new paths have opened up. In addition, maps within Biomes will be flagged by the system so players will never see a repeat map until they have seen every map within the biome at least once. We’re hoping these two changes will help keep the players immersed in the world and minimize feel-bad moments while exploring the Wilds!

Please feel free to explore the changes and let us know what you think in the designated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582200/discussions/0/3825286438464448090/]Discussion Thread[/url]!

[h2]Experimental Branch Save Files[/h2]

A few reminders regarding save files in Sanctuary Saga: there is no method to switch save files back and forth between versions. So if you choose to participate in Experimental, I would recommend either copying your save to a different Save Slot or assign a certain range of your Save Slots to a specific version of the game. For example, you may decide to designate Save Slots 11-15 for playing on the Experimental branch to help with testing, while leaving slots 1-10 dedicated to the Live branch for your prior saves.  While technically the files may work with multiple versions, they won’t always get the updated values (gear costs, skill upgrades, etc). So we recommend designating certain Save Slots to specific game versions. 


Again, we are so grateful for the growing community around Sanctuary Saga and could not be more thankful to those of you along the journey with us! If you haven’t, please consider leaving a review of Sanctuary Saga on Steam (this is massively beneficial to Indie Developers) and sharing out news on your socials. Until next time!
